# UI component libraries available today, per surface

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-corpus.mjs from the component packages' own exports. Do not edit. -->

Build UI from these instead of hand-styling. They follow the theme (light, dark, your token overrides) and are keyboard-accessible.

## Web and Desktop: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`

In `client.js`: `const { Button, Modal } = require('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives')`, and declare the package in `package.json`
`dsh.client.inject` so it loads first. Verified in a real browser (example `client-ui-components`). Props for the common ones are in
`extending/ui-components.md`; for the rest read the package README in `reference/subsystems/client-modules.md` and its `src/<Name>.tsx`.

92 exports:

## CLI: `@earendil-works/pi-tui`

`Container`, `VStack`, `HStack`, `Box`, `Text`, `TruncatedText`, `Markdown`, `SelectList`, `SettingsList`, `Input`, `Editor`, `ScrollView`, `Loader`, `CancellableLoader`, `Spacer`, `Image`, plus `truncateToWidth`, `visibleWidth`, `wrapTextWithAnsi`, `matchesKey`/`Key`, `fuzzyFilter`. Contract and rules: `extending/tui-components.md`.

## Gap

There is no single cross-surface component contract yet: the web primitives and the terminal components are separate stacks with
separate tokens. That is the subject of spec 038 (`specs/038-ui-component-library`).
